_description: Provenance manifest for the real (non-mocked) Gemini rows merged into results/runs.jsonl. Allowlisted fields only -- no full environment dump, no secret-adjacent values (API keys, tokens) anywhere in this file.
huf_commit_note: HEAD of research/safe-deopt-experiment at the time these 5 workers were dispatched; all 600 merged real rows carry this exact huf_commit_hash per-row (verified: single distinct value across results/runs.jsonl).

model.note: provider_reported_model_version is the same string as model_id -- the harness does not separately capture a provider version string distinct from the requested model id; documented honestly rather than fabricating a finer-grained version.

pricing_note: Per the cost-wiring commit (1187f469, 'wire real dollar-cost computation for live LLM rows'). Each row's own pricing_date field ('2026-09-22' throughout) matches this.

seeds.note: Every real (condition, workload, fault, tool_guarantee) cell that actually dispatched a model call has exactly these 2 seeds. Cells for fault F0 (no fault) and F5 do not invoke a model and have no transcript/seed rows by design (see recovery_harness.py); this affects C4/C4+G/C5/C6 uniformly (12 no-model rows per condition) and does not affect C1.

conditions.note: C2 (naive compiled replay) and C3 (deterministic resume) never invoke a model in this harness by construction (see run_experiment.py module docstring) -- they were never candidates for a real run and remain mocked/deterministic-only.

transcripts_location_note: Merged from the 5 workers' results/transcripts.worker*/ directories into a dedicated results/transcripts/real/ subtree (NOT flattened into the top-level results/transcripts/ tree used by mocked rows) -- verification during the merge found that mocked transcripts already occupy the identical <condition>/<workload>/<fault>/<tool_guarantee>/42.json paths for every condition (mocked runs also use seed 42), so a flat merge would have silently overwritten 276 mocked transcript files. Each merged real row's transcript_path field was rewritten accordingly.

plan_reference.note: PLAN_V3.md lives under the workspace's Tracks/ directory, which is gitignored at the workspace-repo level (see .gitignore:26, '/Tracks/*') -- it is a local planning doc, not under version control, so no commit hash exists to point to. Referenced here by its stable local path; file mtime at manifest-write time was 2026-09-22T14:39:33 local.

stale_data_quarantined.note: Before this merge, results/runs.jsonl already contained ONE pre-existing real row (condition C4/W1/F1, seed 42) and results/transcripts/C4/W1/F1/NA/42.json already held a real transcript -- both left over from an earlier one-off smoke test (commit 644f111a) against an OLDER commit hash (4f0160cf...), not the 5-worker run this manifest documents. That stale row/transcript was NOT included in the 600-row merge (it would have double-counted the C4/W1/F1/seed-42 cell against an inconsistent commit hash) and was backed up rather than deleted.
